svg.title: Active-Passive Failover
svg.desc: Active-Passive Failover. A warm standby region is promoted when the primary region goes down. Step 1, One serves, one stands by: All traffic goes to the active region. The standby receives each change a few seconds later. Step 2, Detect, then decide: The active region fails. Only three failed health checks in a row declare it unhealthy. Step 3, Promote, fence, redirect: The replica is promoted, the old primary is fenced, and clients follow as DNS caches expire. Step 4, Fail back on purpose: The failed region rejoins as the standby. Going back is a planned switchover: no data is lost.

g.text: All traffic goes to the active region. The standby receives each change a few seconds later.
The active region fails. Only three failed health checks in a row declare it unhealthy.
The replica is promoted, the old primary is fenced, and clients follow as DNS caches expire.
The failed region rejoins as the standby. Going back is a planned switchover: no data is lost.
